business_summary: Chubb Limited (NYSE: CB) is the world's largest publicly traded property-casualty insurer, a Zurich-domiciled group with global commercial and specialty underwriting. It sits on the hormuz-maritime chain's war-risk-reinsurance-capacity and marine-war-risk-underwriting links. On war-risk-reinsurance-capacity: lead underwriter of the US International Development Finance Corporation Gulf maritime war-risk reinsurance facility, managing the facility, setting pricing and terms, assuming risk and issuing policies for vessels and cargo transiting the strait. On marine-war-risk-underwriting: lead underwriter of the Lloyd's marine war risk consortium issuing primary hull, P&I and cargo war policies for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

exposure_summary.narrative: Chubb Limited sits on two links: war-risk-reinsurance-capacity, scored EMERGING (impact 78, crowdedness 55, capture 52): capacity had to be manufactured rather than bought (a sovereign DFC facility and a separate Lloyd's market consortium), and the trade press's own read is that the episode has not been profitable in aggregate so far; and marine-war-risk-underwriting, scored CROWDED (impact 85, crowdedness 62, capture 45): the chain's own repricing_check reads ATTENTION_WITHOUT_EARNINGS (1 of 4 legs met) because no cited source sizes marine war revenue at any listed insurer even though the premium headline (war-risk cover from roughly 1-3% to 7.5-10% of hull value) has moved. On war-risk-reinsurance-capacity: Lead underwriter of the US International Development Finance Corporation Gulf maritime war-risk reinsurance facility, managing the facility, setting pricing and terms, assuming risk and issuing policies for vessels and cargo transiting the strait. On marine-war-risk-underwriting: Lead underwriter of the Lloyd's marine war risk consortium issuing primary hull, P&I and cargo war policies for vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
